summary: Frontend-only smoke test after signature logo + 6th western photo + baked-in watermarks. All 8 review targets pass: adaptive nav logo swap (light->dark on scroll >40px), footer logo, 6 western items with new /west-riders.jpg 'The Wranglers' at index 2, lightbox cycles through all 6 unique sources, travel 4 + prints 3 all load, journal modal open/close, contact prefill + inquiry_type=print + form submit + persistence via GET /api/inquiries, no broken images, no 'Made with Emergent' badge, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx uses two different testids: contact-email (the mailto <a>) and contact-email-input (the actual form <input>). Fine, but easy to confuse — the initial review request said 'contact form submit still works and persists via GET /api/inquiries' — email input testid is contact-email-input.
Lightbox.jsx uses data-testid='lightbox' (single, shared by both galleries). Review request refers to 'western-lightbox' — the actual testid is just 'lightbox'. Not a bug, just naming.
Navbar swaps src based on 'scrolled' state which triggers a network re-fetch on each toggle (both files already exist in /app/frontend/public so no 404). Optionally could preload both. Not blocking.
Western grid uses md:auto-rows-[180px] with row-span-2 (360px tall tiles) — new 6th item (col-5) fits alongside col-7 in the third row cleanly. Layout verified visually.
west-riders.jpg (210KB), sunburst-print.jpg (301KB), logo-light.png (87KB), logo-dark.png (47KB) all present in /app/frontend/public with expected sizes.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth on this app

All tiles fully filled (aspect ratios preserved via object-cover + md:h-full). Note: lightbox testid is 'lightbox' (single), not 'western-lightbox'. No 'Made with Emergent' badge. Note: email input testid = 'contact-email-input' (contact-email is the mailto link).
